subject: Quick technical triage before full demo — Novus Retail
messages:
From: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@novusretail.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-21T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quick 15-min tech triage before Redwood demo?

Hi Karthik,

We signed up for a trial yesterday and the platform looks promising — thanks for the quick onboarding emails. Before we take a full demo with the product team, our infrastructure group has asked for a short technical screen (15 minutes) to confirm SSO, data flow, and retention policies. Would someone from your side be available today for a quick call? Prefer windows around 10:30–11:30am PST, but we can do tomorrow morning as well.

Top things they want to cover quickly:
- Okta SAML compatibility and SCIM provisioning
- Data retention / audit log windows (compliance)
- Basic network requirements and IP allowlisting

If you can send a short checklist or confirmation ahead of the call, that would help us get the right folks on.

Thanks,
Sarah
Sarah Lee
Director, Platform
Novus Retail
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@novusretail.com>
Cc: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-21T09:35:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick 15-min tech triage before Redwood demo?

Hi Sarah — thanks for the note and welcome to Redwood. We can absolutely do a 15-minute triage to walk through SSO, retention, and network. I attached a one-page triage checklist that covers the items you mentioned.

Two quick slots that work for our infra folks: 10:45–11:00am PST today or 9:00–9:15am PST tomorrow. You can also pick a time directly here: https://calendly.com/redwood/trial-15min

In the 15-minute call we'll aim to confirm:
- SSO method (Okta SAML) and whether you need SCIM provisioning
- Data residency & log retention windows we offer by plan
- Any IP allowlist / egress rules you need to validate
- Expected token/throughput profile (rough numbers to set expectations)

Ava, Ben — putting you both on this thread as technical backup. If Sarah picks today, either of you ok to hop in? Ben can bring projected latency/cost numbers for a standard cart-search workload; Ava can handle SSO detail.

Sarah — let me know which slot works and I’ll calendar it and send a quick invite.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Sales Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- novus-triage-checklist.pdf (pdf)
From: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@novusretail.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-21T09:50:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick 15-min tech triage before Redwood demo?

Thanks — 10:45–11:00am PST today works for us. I booked the Calendly slot and added our infra lead (mike.jenner@novusretail.com). Couple quick questions to prep our infra team:

1) We use Okta SAML. Do you support SCIM user provisioning or just SAML for login?
2) For compliance we need 90-day audit log retention; is that available out of the box or via an add-on?

If you can address those two briefly on the call we should be set. See you in ~20 minutes.

—Sarah
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@novusretail.com>, Mike Jenner <mike.jenner@novusretail.com>
Date: 2027-09-21T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick 15-min tech triage before Redwood demo? (internal + confirmation)

Confirmed: 10:45–11:00am PST today — invite sent to Sarah and Mike. Internal plan below (short):

- Ava: lead SSO discussion (SAML flow diagram + whether SCIM provisioning supported). Bring note: we support SAML and optional SCIM via SCIM API (provisioning available on Dedicated/Private plans).
- Ben: have quick numbers ready (p50/p95 token latency for 1–4k RPS equivalent, rough cost per 1M tokens at suggested batching) and a one-line fallback plan if latency exceeds SLOs.
- Karthik: intro + scope alignment, confirm retention ask (90d) and call out where audit logs are stored (control plane vs customer-managed).

I attached the demo scope doc with two suggested follow-ups (full demo and architecture deep-dive). After the triage, if Novus wants to proceed we can schedule a 60-minute architecture session next week.

Thanks — see you on the call.

Karthik

Attachments:
- novus-demo-scope.docx (docx)
